objects.name: cover_platform
facts: страхование оформляется внутри банка, без внешнего партнёра
клиент и менеджер работают в одном контуре
objects.object: a stylized bank building with classical columns enclosed by a translucent protective dome, a small laptop and a tablet resting on the front steps
details: a glossy red shield emblem on the building pediment
the dome softly glowing red at its base, meaning everything stays inside the bank perimeter
objects.meaning: insurance products sold fully inside the bank's own perimeter

objects.name: step_catalog
facts: клиент видит страховку рядом с банковскими продуктами
objects.object: a laptop showing a grid of product tiles without any text
details: one tile raised out of the screen with a small red shield on it
neighbouring tiles show a card and a coin symbol
objects.meaning: insurance offered right next to banking products in the online bank

objects.name: step_quote
facts: условия и цена считаются по данным компании
objects.object: a company document folder feeding into a compact price calculator
details: a small red stopwatch leaning on the calculator
data sheets sliding from the folder into the calculator
objects.meaning: the price is calculated in a minute from the company's own data

objects.name: step_payment
objects.object: a payment order sheet with a red round stamp coming out of a bank account vault door
details: a bank card attached to the vault door
a curved arrow from the vault to the sheet
objects.meaning: payment from the company account is prepared automatically
